description.en: A moist loaf made from overripe bananas.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 175 °C a formu na chlebík vylož papierom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 175 °C and line a loaf tin with parchment.

steps.sk: Banány roztlač vidličkou a vymiešaj s rozpusteným maslom, cukrom a vajcami.
steps.en: Mash the bananas with a fork and mix with the melted butter, sugar and eggs.

steps.sk: Primiešaj múku so sódou, škoricou a soľou a nakoniec nasekané orechy. Nemiešaj dlho, stačí, kým sa suroviny spoja.
steps.en: Fold in the flour with the baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then the chopped walnuts. Mix only until combined.

steps.sk: Cesto vlej do formy a peč 50 až 55 minút. Je hotový, keď špajdľa zapichnutá do stredu vyjde suchá.
steps.en: Pour into the tin and bake for 50–55 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.

steps.sk: Nechaj vychladnúť vo forme 10 minút, potom na mriežke.
steps.en: Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then on a rack.

description.sk: Tradičný slovenský sladký obed zo zemiakového cesta.
description.en: A traditional Slovak sweet lunch made from potato dough.

note.en: boiled in their skins and cooled

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke doměkka, asi 25 minút, ošúp a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender, about 25 minutes, then peel and cool.

steps.sk: Najemno ich nastrúhaj a s múkou, vajcom a soľou rýchlo vypracuj hladké cesto.
steps.en: Grate them finely and quickly knead with the flour, egg and salt into a smooth dough.

steps.sk: Z cesta vyvaľkaj valček, nakrájaj kúsky a dlaňami z nich vyšúľaj prstové šúľance.
steps.en: Roll the dough into a log, cut it into pieces and roll each between your palms into finger-shaped noodles.

steps.sk: Var ich v osolenej vode, kým nevyplávajú na povrch, a ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Boil in salted water until they float, then for 2 more minutes.

steps.sk: Sceď ich, prelož do misy s rozpusteným maslom a posyp makom zmiešaným s cukrom.
steps.en: Drain, toss with the melted butter and sprinkle with the poppy seeds mixed with the sugar.

description.sk: Zapekaná mliečna ryža s jablkami a škoricou.
description.en: Baked milky rice with apples and cinnamon.

steps.sk: Ryžu var v mlieku s vanilkovým cukrom na miernom ohni 20 minút do mäkka, občas premiešaj. Nechaj trochu vychladnúť.
steps.en: Simmer the rice in the milk with the vanilla sugar over low heat for 20 minutes until soft, stirring occasionally. Let it cool a little.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Žĺtky vymiešaj s polovicou cukru a vmiešaj do ryže, z bielkov a zvyšného cukru vyšľahaj tuhý sneh a zľahka ho primiešaj.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Beat the yolks with half the sugar and stir into the rice; whisk the whites with the remaining sugar to stiff peaks and fold in gently.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu vymaž maslom, vrstvi ryžu a nastrúhané jablká so škoricou a hrozienkami, navrch daj vločky masla.
steps.en: Butter a baking dish and layer the rice with the grated apples, cinnamon and raisins; dot the top with butter.

steps.sk: Peč 30 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Bake for 30 minutes until golden.

title.sk: Pečené jablká s orechmi a medom
title.en: Baked apples with walnuts and honey

description.sk: Jednoduchý jesenný dezert z pár surovín.
description.en: A simple autumn dessert from a few ingredients.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Jablkám vykroj jadrovníky tak, aby zostalo dno.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Core the apples, leaving the base intact.

steps.sk: Nasekané orechy zmiešaj s medom, škoricou a hrozienkami a naplň nimi jablká. Navrch daj kúsok masla.
steps.en: Mix the chopped walnuts with the honey, cinnamon and raisins and fill the apples. Top each with a little butter.

steps.sk: Peč 25 minút, kým jablká nie sú mäkké a šupka nepopraská.
steps.en: Bake for 25 minutes until the apples are soft and the skins split.

description.sk: Hutné a vlhké brownies pre milovníkov čokolády.
description.en: Dense, fudgy brownies for chocolate lovers.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C a formu 20 × 20 cm vylož papierom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a 20 × 20 cm tin with parchment.

steps.sk: Čokoládu s maslom roztop nad parou alebo v mikrovlnke po krátkych intervaloch.
steps.en: Melt the chocolate with the butter over a pan of simmering water or in short bursts in the microwave.

steps.sk: Vajcia vyšľahaj s cukrom do svetlej peny a vmiešaj čokoládu. Primiešaj múku, kakao a soľ.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs with the sugar until pale and stir in the chocolate. Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt.

steps.sk: Vlej do formy a peč 22 až 25 minút. Stred má zostať mierne vlhký – špajdľa vyjde s pár omrvinkami.
steps.en: Pour into the tin and bake for 22–25 minutes. The centre should stay slightly moist; a skewer comes out with a few crumbs.

steps.sk: Nechaj úplne vychladnúť a až potom krájaj.
steps.en: Let it cool completely before cutting.
